technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish technicals (supertrend, hull, psar) conflicting with weak intermediate/long-term structure (price below key MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, negative CMF/AO); neutral sector momentum provides no tailwind.

fundamental.summary: TXN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional buy signals from junior members combined with extreme market fear (32 Fear/Greed score) presents contrarian opportunity, but conviction is low and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (359.68), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, strong USD pressuring multinational earnings, CPI event in 1 day, and earnings binary in 14 days create compounded downside risk for TXN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technicals (supertrend, hull, psar bullish) + extreme fear sentiment (32 Fear/Greed) + price near support (136.30) create contrarian entry opportunity with defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, strong USD, flat yield curve), high earnings risk in 14 days, price below all key moving averages, negative momentum (CMF/AO), zero fundamental conviction, and CPI event in 1 day create compounded downside risk that overwhelms short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term technicals (supertrend, hull, psar) offer contrarian appeal near support in extreme fear environment, but macro headwinds and earnings binary within 14 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days combined with VIX crisis (359.68), strong USD headwind, and price below all key moving averages creates binary event risk with negative momentum (CMF/AO) providing no support on breakdown.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding TXN with 23 existing IT positions (5.4% sector concentration) and zero portfolio drawdown buffer; adding to concentration during macro crisis and earnings window violates risk discipline.
